notes: Held-out task set for the Phase 1 eval suite. Hashes are sha256 of the canonical task record (id, kind, description, fixture file bytes) — the runner verifies them before running. Seeds select scripted demo-model behaviour: 0 = correct, 1 = noisy (wrong fix / extra false-positive finding), 2 = sloppy (no fix / fake citation). The demo model is scripted; these evals measure the harness (budgets, checks, ablations), not model capability. Real models plug in via the same runner.
